response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT p.bats AS bats, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), totals AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM counts) SELECT c.bats, c.cnt, c.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS share, c.cnt * 1.0 / t.avg_cnt AS count_to_avg_ratio FROM counts c CROSS JOIN totals t;
